ui.autostartTitle: Run DynamicDesktop automatically when you sign in

ui.autostartWarnSw: DynamicDesktop didn't start automatically this time — {sw} may have blocked it. Open {sw}, find DynamicDesktop in its startup manager and set it to Allow.
ui.autostartWarnGeneric: DynamicDesktop didn't start automatically this time — your security software or the Windows Startup apps setting may have blocked it. Turn DynamicDesktop on in your security software's startup manager, or in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.

ui.previewNoIcons: Live preview · desktop icons are hidden
ui.refreshTitle: Generate a new scene for this theme
ui.shareImageTitle: Share your desktop image while protecting your privacy
ui.shareVideoTitle: Share your desktop animation while protecting your privacy
ui.sharePrivacy: Icons are replaced with sample icons and file names with color blocks, so none of your files are shown.
ui.shareCopiedImage: The image is on your clipboard — paste it straight into a chat or a post.
ui.shareCopiedVideo: The video file is on your clipboard — paste it into a chat window to send it.
ui.autosave: Changes are saved automatically and applied to your desktop right away
ui.resetAllTitle: Reset all settings of this theme to their defaults
ui.helpWallpaperQ: DynamicDesktop keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular Windows wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make DynamicDesktop flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart DynamicDesktop after changing this setting.
ui.ongoingDesc: New scenes and elements will be added over time.
ui.noParams: This theme has no settings yet
ui.locationHint: Used for automatic lighting. Without coordinates, lighting follows the selected time zone; leave it blank to use the system time zone.
ui.locationInvalid: Enter both valid coordinates: latitude −90 to 90 and longitude −180 to 180.
ui.timeZoneInvalid: Enter a valid IANA time zone, for example Europe/Amsterdam.
ui.locationChoose: Choose a result to apply it.
ui.locationNoResults: No match. Try another city name or a Dutch postcode.
ui.locationSearchError: Location search is unavailable. Check your connection and try again.

host.welcomeBody:
Click the beach icon in the system tray{hotkey} to open the menu.
Can't see it? Click ^ on the right side of the taskbar.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: Windows kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so DynamicDesktop has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.
